title: Mexican Pork Tenderloin
description: A delicious and flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring a tenderloin of pork, marinated in a blend of spices and baked to perfection.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, cumin, coriander, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Place the pork tenderloin in a large zip-top plastic bag or a shallow dish.
Pour the marinade over the pork and massage to coat.
Seal the bag or cover the dish with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
